caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with ornate detailing, viewed at a slight angle from the front left. The chair features a dark brown wood frame with a high back that is decorated with intricate carved patterns, including a shell motif at the crest and interlacing curves below it. The arms of the chair are elegantly curved, with tightly scrolled ends, and the front legs are also carved with decorative motifs, ending in claw-and-ball feet. The seat is upholstered in what appears to be a muted, olive-green fabric, with the wooden seat rail visible underneath. The composition centers the chair on a plain, beige background, with no other objects present. The drawing is rendered with attention to texture and shading, giving the chair a three-dimensional appearance, and a thin, single-lined rectangular border frames the image.
title: Arm Chair
